notes:
Reviewed commit d356f55 (frontend store actions + types) across stores/funnels.ts, types/funnel.ts, tests/stores/funnels.spec.ts.

Contract compliance (verified):
- All four new actions (duplicate, stopAllExecutions, testRun, preview) mirror the existing activate/pause shape exactly: error.value=false at entry, catch flips error.value=true and RE-THROWS. No action swallows.
- Store NEVER calls useApiError. grep -n 'useApiError' shows 4 hits, all in comments (lines 18,21,128,203) — zero actual invocations. No Pinia-action crash risk.
- All four exported from the returned store object; the `delete` alias remains intact.

URLs / methods / body (cross-checked vs FunnelController.java @RequestMapping('/api/v1/projects/{projectId}/funnels')):
- duplicate  -> POST {listUrl()}/{id}/duplicate           (controller @PostMapping('/{funnelId}/duplicate'), 201 FunnelResponse) MATCH
- stopAll    -> POST {listUrl()}/{id}/executions/stop      (@PostMapping('/{funnelId}/executions/stop'), 200 StopAllResponse) MATCH
- testRun    -> POST {listUrl()}/{id}/test-run             (@PostMapping('/{funnelId}/test-run'), 200 Void) MATCH
- preview    -> POST {listUrl()}/{id}/steps/{stepId}/preview with body: payload (@PostMapping('/{funnelId}/steps/{stepId}/preview'), 200 PreviewStepResponse) MATCH
listUrl() derives projectId from route param (idiom from subscribers.ts), matching controller base path. No manual XSRF headers — useApi.ts onRequest auto-attaches X-XSRF-TOKEN for non-safe methods.

duplicate correctly calls syncRow(created) for contract symmetry (no-op when copy id absent from list) and does NOT fabricate a synthetic FunnelSummaryResponse — matches task spec and edge-case note.

Types (cross-checked vs backend DTO records):
- PreviewStepRequest {stepType: StepType; text: string; parseMode?: string|null} vs record PreviewStepRequest(String stepType, String text, String parseMode) — MATCH (StepType union reused; parseMode optional/nullable consistent with @JsonIgnoreProperties record).
- PreviewStepResponse {rendered: string; sampleData: boolean; kind: 'message'|'non_message'} vs record(String rendered, boolean sampleData, String kind) — MATCH, no ownerChatId/identity leakage.
- StopAllResponse {cancelled: number} vs record(long cancelled) — MATCH (long->number).
All three also match tech-spec Data Models exactly. Doc-comments reference backend DTO FQN + Decision number per file convention.

Testing: 8 new vitest cases (happy + error path for each action) assert URL/method/body and error-flag-rethrow. Full spec green: 18/18 passed. vue-tsc --noEmit clean for touched files.

No critical/major/minor findings. Production-ready.
